sentences.en: Local logistics company Everest Port Services Ltd has won a six-month contract to operate Chittagong Container Terminal (CCT) at Chattogram port, replacing local operator Saif Powertec Ltd.

Nine months into the biggest energy shock in modern history, the oil market’s recovery is surprisingly swift, but plentiful crude supplies are masking a stubborn diesel shortage that could yet upend fuel markets.
In a bid to move from a major agricultural producer to a global price-setter, Vietnam is laying the groundwork for a domestic commodity derivatives market.
Last year, I was sitting in the waiting area of a GP clinic in Singapore, and my serial number was 11.

BRAC Bank PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Heidelberg Materials Bangladesh PLC, one of the country’s largest cement manufacturers, to provide distributor-financing facilities to the company’s distribution network.

Bangladesh is showcasing its tea, processed food and agricultural products at the fourth International Food and Agriculture Exhibition (FoodAg 2026) in Karachi, Pakistan, seeking to tap export opportunities and forge new business links with international buyers.

Bad loans in the country’s banking sector continue to rise despite years of generous forbearance measures by the central bank, including loan restructuring, rescheduling, interest waivers and one-time exit facilities.

The Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) has issued a show-cause notice to Robi Axiata PLC, asking why the telecom operator should not be directed to stop using the brand name “Cirkle”.

Chattogram’s strategic location beside the country’s premier seaport and its growing industrial base offer huge potential to attract German investors, German Ambassador to Bangladesh Rüdiger Lotz has said.

Uttara Motors Limited, the distributor of Suzuki passenger vehicles in Bangladesh, has launched the all-new Suzuki Dzire, featuring sophisticated styling, modern technology, enhanced comfort and everyday practicality.

agricultural.def: A product or commodity from agriculture.

distributor.def: One who or that which distributes.

facilities.def: Facilities for urination and defecation: a toilet; a lavatory.

potential.def: Currently unrealized ability (with the most common adposition being to)

commodity.def: Anything movable (a good) that is bought and sold.
